newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin sacks defence minister, general staff head.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin sacks defence minister, general staff head.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin on Thursday sacked both Defence Minister Igor Rodionov and the head of the general staff, General Viktor Samsonov, the Kremlin press service said.
A spokesman said Yeltsin had appointed Igor Sergeyev, commander of the strategic forces, as acting defence minister.
Yeltsin, speaking at a meeting of the Defence Council, which is attended by top commanders and is discussing military reform, accused the top brass of doing nothing to reform the army.
"I am not simply dissatisfied, I am indignant over the state of reforms in the army and the general state of the armed forces," Itar-Tass news agency quoted Yeltsin as saying.
"You have done a bad job in this direction. I am not satisfied and must draw conclusions," he was quoted as telling Rodionov, appointed a year ago, and other senior generals.

Rodionov had been at odds with Yeltsin's top defence adviser, Yuri Baturin, over the course of military reforms. The minister said the state must provide more funding before change to the underfunded and demoralised force can start.
